claims.text: The Indexing (Push) API pushes documents, users, permissions, metadata.
claims.excerpt: The Indexing API (also known as the Push API) pushes documents, users, permissions, and metadata to Glean.

claims.text: The Client API is for custom client interfaces.
claims.excerpt: The Client API enables implementation of a custom client interface to interact with the Glean system.

claims.text: Indexing API accepts only Glean-issued tokens.
claims.excerpt: The Indexing API only supports Glean-issued tokens - OAuth authentication is not available.

claims.text: Activity uses a Client API token.
claims.excerpt: the activity endpoint needs to be called with a client API bearer token (as opposed to an indexing API bearer token for other endpoints).

claims.text: Activity needs a global Client token scoped to ACTIVITY.
claims.excerpt: we need a Global client API token scoped to ACTIVITY.

claims.text: The SDK is a client for the Indexing API.
claims.excerpt: The SDK is a client for the Indexing API, not a replacement - the API documentation stays the reference for the wire protocol.

claims.text: Datasource name: ASCII letters and digits only.
claims.excerpt: CustomDatasourceConfig.name may contain only ASCII letters and digits

claims.text: urlRegex must be neither too broad nor too narrow.
claims.excerpt: Avoid regexes that are too broad, and will capture URLs from other datasources, or regexes that are too narrow

claims.text: isUserReferencedByEmail decides email vs ID references.
claims.excerpt: This should be set to true if you want to refer to user identities using emails directly.

claims.text: Datasource category affects ranking.
claims.excerpt: Choosing the appropriate type enables enhanced ranking.

claims.text: Set per-object category with docCategory.
claims.excerpt: please set each category using objectDefinitions.docCategory

claims.text: Do not use the PEOPLE category.
claims.excerpt: This should not be used, please instead use the /bulkindexemployees API to upload data about employees

claims.text: Test datasources have ranking signals off.
claims.excerpt: All ranking signals are turned off from a test datasource.

claims.text: Beta users still need document permissions.
claims.excerpt: For a document to be visible to beta users, they must also have appropriate permissions to view it.

claims.text: JSON and XML MIME types are not supported for content.
claims.excerpt: application/jsonJSON fileapplication/xmlXML file

claims.text: Items over 64 MB index metadata and permissions only.
claims.excerpt: If the size is GREATER than 64 MB, the crawler WILL NOT download the item contents and will only download the metadata and permissions information for indexing.

claims.text: Indexable text is truncated at 16.875 MB.
claims.excerpt: If the content is greater than 16.875 MB, then the first 16.875 MB of content will be stored and fed to the indexer.

claims.text: Spreadsheets index about 250,000 characters.
claims.excerpt: By default, approximately 250,000 characters of spreadsheet content are indexed.

claims.text: Apply the size limits to custom connectors too.
claims.excerpt: This speaks to Native Connector size limits, but should also be followed for Indexing documents into a Custom Connector

claims.text: Timestamps are epoch seconds.
claims.excerpt: created_at and updated_at must be epoch seconds, not ISO strings.

claims.text: 413 means the request is too large; split it.
claims.excerpt: 413 Request Entity Too LargeDocument/request too largeSplit into smaller requests or use bulk operations

claims.text: /indexdocument 10 rps; /indexdocuments 600 docs/min.
claims.excerpt: /indexdocument10 requests per second/indexdocuments600 documents per minute

claims.text: /indexdocuments is for incremental updates.
claims.excerpt: /indexdocuments: This endpoint is intended for incremental updates.

claims.text: Bulk indexing replaces the datasource; omitted documents are deleted.
claims.excerpt: Bulk indexing fully replaces the entire list of documents stored in Glean. After a successful bulk upload, all documents that were not a part of the most recent upload are deleted asynchronously.

claims.text: One unique uploadId per upload session.
claims.excerpt: You need to have a unique uploadId for all the paginated requests you send for an upload.

claims.text: No concurrent bulk uploads.
claims.excerpt: Concurrent uploads are not allowed ie. you cannot start a new upload before the previous upload is finished.

claims.text: After a failed upload, forceRestartUpload is required.
claims.excerpt: Not specifying this bit in case of an unsuccessful previous upload will fail the request.

claims.text: /processalldocuments reprocesses without a new upload.
claims.excerpt: This re-indexes all previously uploaded documents without requiring a new upload.

claims.text: Use /processalldocuments for immediate deletions.
claims.excerpt: If you wish for deletions to take effect immediately, use /processalldocuments endpoint.

claims.text: /processalldocuments: once every 3 hours per datasource.
claims.excerpt: /processalldocuments1 request every 3 hours per data source

claims.text: Stale deletion pauses 7 days above 20%.
claims.excerpt: we have a deletion check in place which pauses the deletion of stale documents for 7 days if the percentage of docs being deleted exceeds 20%.

claims.text: Index users before referencing them.
claims.excerpt: When using non-anonymous permissions, users need to be indexed before being referenced.

claims.text: Index a group before its memberships.
claims.excerpt: groupName: A group with this particular groupName must be indexed before indexing memberships for it.

claims.text: Indexing a user grants no document access.
claims.excerpt: Note that this does not give permissions to the users to search for the document

claims.text: Nested groups use memberGroupName.
claims.excerpt: that can be done by using the memberGroupName field in place of the memberUserId field

claims.text: Group names: no whitespace, not empty, no 'scio' prefix.
claims.excerpt: Cannot start with the prefix "scio"

claims.text: Permissions and memberships process asynchronously.
claims.excerpt: Permissions and memberships are processed asynchronously

claims.text: Use /processallmemberships for identity problems.
claims.excerpt: For issues with user or group permissions rather than document content, use /processallmemberships instead.

claims.text: Intersection semantics.
claims.excerpt: A user must belong to every group within one entry; multiple entries are alternative intersections.

claims.text: allowAnonymousAccess exposes the document to every signed-in user.
claims.excerpt: allowAnonymousAccessIf set to true, anyone who is signed into Glean can view search results for the document

claims.text: allowAllDatasourceUsersAccess requires the user to be indexed as a datasource user.
claims.excerpt: allowAllDatasourceUsersAccess is true and user has been indexed as a user of the connector

claims.text: Define custom properties before uploading.
claims.excerpt: It is highly recommended to configure custom properties first and then upload documents with the custom properties.

claims.text: Custom property updates need a full re-upload.
claims.excerpt: Updating a custom property requires re-uploading the entire document via /indexdocument.

claims.text: Only Custom Properties support INT, DATE, USERID.
claims.excerpt: Custom Properties support INT, DATE, and USERID types; Custom Metadata does not.

claims.text: Custom Metadata works on any datasource without re-indexing.
claims.excerpt: It can attach metadata to documents from any datasource, including native connectors, without re-indexing the source document.

claims.text: Re-indexing does not change Custom Metadata.
claims.excerpt: Re-indexing a document via the Indexing API does not affect Custom Metadata attached to it.

claims.text: INT properties are not faceted.
claims.excerpt: propertyType "INT" is not faceted.

claims.text: DATE facets need epoch seconds.
claims.excerpt: propertyType "DATE" is only faceted if specified value is an epoch timestamp in seconds.

claims.text: Rendering properties in results needs Glean support.
claims.excerpt: Contact Glean support to show the custom property to the search result as per your preference.

claims.text: The 'country' property is a location ranking signal.
claims.excerpt: its value is used as a ranking signal to personalize results based on the searcher's location.

claims.text: Custom property validation fails fast on the first error.
claims.excerpt: Validation stops at the first invalid custom property it encounters.

claims.text: Native and custom connectors use separate namespaces.
claims.excerpt: Native and custom connectors occupy separate namespaces in Glean.

claims.text: Use an existing connector before building a new one.
claims.excerpt: Work to leverage an existing connector first before building a new one

claims.text: No activity means weaker ranking.
claims.excerpt: There would be limited signals available due to no activity being pushed, so rankings of search results will be suboptimal.

claims.text: Custom results can be outranked without signals.
claims.excerpt: Results from your custom connector are more likely to be outranked by results from other connectors due to stronger ranking signals.

claims.text: Deployment limit: 8,000 rpm across IPs.
claims.excerpt: 8,000 requests per minute across all IP addresses

claims.text: Deployment limit: 100 rps from one IP.
claims.excerpt: 100 requests per second from a single IP address

claims.text: /indexdocument can return 400, 401, 409, 429.
claims.excerpt: OK Bad Request Not Authorized Conflict Too Many Requests

claims.text: Documents are searchable after processingHistory passes bulkUploadHistory.
claims.excerpt: After documents are uploaded, they will be queued for processing. New documents will be available in search results when the processingHistory timestamp is after the bulkUploadHistory.

claims.text: UPLOAD COMPLETED is acceptance, not searchability.
claims.excerpt: UPLOAD COMPLETED only means the API accepted your upload. It doesn't mean users are indexed and searchable.

claims.text: Wrong pagination flags can make a partial upload look complete.
claims.excerpt: Incorrect pagination can cause partial uploads to be treated as complete.

claims.text: Support tickets need issue, endpoint/body, connector name, timestamp/timezone.
claims.excerpt: Description of the issue including error message

claims.text: The datasource must be enabled for search.
claims.excerpt: For the indexed document to show up in Glean UI, the datasource must be enabled for search.

claims.text: First-run: one public, then one permissioned document, then scale.
claims.excerpt: Index a single public sample document and confirm it appears in search. Then index one permissioned document and confirm only authorized users can see it. Once both behave correctly, scale up.

claims.text: Do not flatten groups into users.
claims.excerpt: Don't flatten groups into user lists
